Sell the product a store product is mapped to as that store product on its provider: apps are
offered it and paywalls list it, with its offers, from then on. A product sells one store product
per provider; the one it sold before stays linked but is no longer offered to new buyers, and people
who bought it keep their access.

It changes what new buyers are offered, so it asks first; --yes skips that.

Usage:
  voidhash provider sell [store-product] [flags]

Arguments:
  store-product  The store's id for it, as 'provider products' lists it

Flags:
  -h, --help                 Show help for this command
      --json                 Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>    Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                             this directory's project, then your default project)
      --provider <provider>  The provider selling it (app-store, google-play, stripe, a payment
                             source's slug); needed only when several do
  -q, --quiet                Print only ids, one per line
  -y, --yes                  Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider sell com.acme.pro.monthly.v2
  voidhash provider sell prod_123:price_789 --provider stripe --yes
